payload: {"scratch": "d04-d12 Patterns: 1) counter_k1 is the primary multi-resident morning hub (P~0.80) for persistent items (backpacks, mugs, phones, keys, lunchboxes, water bottles). Prioritize over bedrooms when residents are in kitchen. 2) coffee_table_l1 is a high-probability (P~0.80) static drop zone for Leo's personal items (phone, headphones, bowl, mug, laptop) even when absent. Contradicts 'personal territory' model; prioritize over desk_b2/nightstand_b2. 3) nightstand_b1 is a high-probability (P~0.80) static drop zone for Mara's phone and glasses, whether present or absent. 4) nightstand_b3 is a static storage hub for Sofia's charger (P~0.70), medication (P~0.80), and phone (P~0.80); low probability for other items. 5) bookshelf_l1 is a static drop zone for Leo's charger (P~0.50) even when absent; prioritize over desk_b2/nightstand_b2. 6) entry_table_e1 is unreliable for static storage (P~0.15-0.20 for phones when away); keys rarely found here. 7) cupboard_k1 is often empty; do not forecast personal items there without evidence. 8) bed_b1 is not a drop zone for Mara's phone/glasses (P~0.05); validates nightstand_b1 as primary. 9) sink_k1 is a drop zone for mugs (mug_mara P~0.40) and wallets (wallet_leo P~0.30). 10) dish_rack_k1 holds pot_1 (P high). 11) Leo is frequently active in kitchen during mornings; often co-occurs with Mara. 12) Absence of remote_1/laptop_leo at coffee_table_l1 lowers their priors there. 13) Absence of books at bookshelf_l1 lowers their priors there. 14) desk_b3 is static storage for Sofia's grooming items (hairbrush, makeup kit) (P~0.80) even when absent; prioritize over bathroom_shelf_ba1. 15) bed_b3 is not a drop zone for Sofia's personal items (P~0.05). 16) desk_b2 is not a static drop zone for Leo's items (P~0.05) even when home. Lowers priors for laptop/phone/notebook/charger/mug at desk_b2. Prioritize coffee_table_l1 (laptop), nightstand_b2 (phone), bookshelf_l1 (charger), counter_k1 (mug) over desk_b2 for Leo's items. d12 Sat 09:20: bedroom_floor_b3 holds wallet_sofia; nobody. Confirms bedroom_floor_b3 as static drop zone for Sofia's wallet (P~0.80). Prioritize over entry_table_e1/counter_k1 for wallet searches. Absence of jacket/backpack/phone lowers their priors here; prioritize counter_k1 (backpack), entry_hook_e1 (jacket), nightstand_b3/counter_k1 (phone)."}
